item.title: Most Of The Fiber We Built Is Still Dark
item.description: By the most widely cited estimates, the large majority of the long-haul fiber the US laid in the dotcom buildout has never been lit. The reason isn't 'supply outran demand' — it's that lighting fiber is cheap and the adjacent stack isn't. The same pattern is shaping the AI infrastructure buildout right now.
